sources.stated_purpose: Published crime-tip mailbox for the Sheriff's Office Investigations Division.
sources.limitations: Crime tips only, not general correspondence, emergency dispatch, or an official incident report. Confirm venue, remit, and appropriate reporting method. General contact page explicitly directs official business to telephone directory; do not use webmaster. Do not send confidential records through ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
